name: assetpanda/lp-prose
title: AP Lp Prose
description: One section of a long-form page (legal pages, guides, webinar notes): an optional anchored heading over rich text (paragraphs, lists, tables, quotes, images, links) set in the kit's reading type on a centred 760px column. Stack one per heading so the page-toc panel can jump between them. lead: the opening paragraph(s) in larger type; panel: the section on a soft rounded panel (contact boxes, summaries). This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
